analysis.scope: Derive repeatable teaching and visual practices from the exact three published handcrafted reference movies.
analysis.method: Complete narration read; visual inspection of every encoded scene sheet including early/middle/late beats, change peaks, long holds, transitions and end states; 17 additional native 1920x1080 encoded frames; selected executable computational film source read. This is not continuous playback with sound, independent factual certification, or publication approval.

principles.instruction: Choose one concrete, small worked example whose state persists across the central explanation. Compute the displayed quantities from the same data that drives the picture. Assert exact numerical results and important invariants in the authoring source.

references.observed: The same Birds and sing states become query/key geometry and two explicit dot products; the longer off-angle key beats the short aligned key.
Weighted corpus tiles physically merge while a shared computation updates pair counts, the ordered merge list and position total 30 to 23 to 16 to 11.
The 16-block pool, request ownership and block table persist as logical position 5 maps through logical block 1 and slot 1 to physical block 2.

principles.why: Learners can check the mechanism and compare states without decoding a fresh example at every cut. Arithmetic errors cannot hide behind attractive labels.

principles.instruction: Make motion perform the operation being taught: merge, route, add, allocate, copy, reject or accumulate. Name what changes and what observable result follows. Camera movement, glow, generic particles and sequential card reveals do not substitute for a mechanism.

references.observed: The two value vectors scale by shares and add tip to tail to the contextual output point.
A branch's shared partial block moves to a free location, its block table changes, both ownership counts update, and separate appends preserve each future.
Characters open into their actual UTF-8 bytes; independent decoding loses the characters; gathering the bytes reconstructs the text.

principles.why: Removing the animation would remove explanatory information rather than only decoration.

principles.instruction: At a conceptual hinge, ask for a prediction, change one meaningful input or assumption, retain the rest of the state, then show the result and its cause. Include a failure case or limiting case that distinguishes the mechanism from a plausible wrong rule.

references.observed: Changing a score moves the output toward its value; making both values equal leaves the output fixed despite changing shares and makes the score gradient zero.
Adding only rainb to the vocabulary makes greedy longest-match choose it and lose the whole rainbow word, although rain plus continuation bow was valid.
Lowering only the whole-piece probability from .30 to .01 flips the best complete path to .15 times .10, disproving a longest-piece rule.
Paged and continuous attention give the same computed output; reading one invalid sentinel slot changes the output drastically.

principles.why: A viewer learns to predict behavior and reject a misconception instead of remembering an attractive demonstration.

principles.instruction: Introduce a mathematical expression through a picture or operation, then connect each symbol, axis, unit and dimension to that picture. Keep the numerical example and notation consistent when changing representation.

references.observed: Individual attention becomes Q times K transpose, scaled row softmax, then V; unequal matrix shapes reveal the missing transpose and wrong normalization axis.
Keys and values, layers and KV heads occupy independent slab axes and correspond to 2 x 32 x 8 x 128 x 2 bytes, producing 128 KiB per token.
Equal fixed text spans at three and four characters per token show why a one-third rate increase gives a one-quarter position decrease.

principles.why: The formula becomes a compact account of something the viewer already understands.

principles.instruction: Give entities stable colors, names and positions. Use hierarchy and generous spacing to focus one question at a time. Use 3D only when its axes, volume or viewpoint teach a real property; choose 2D when it makes the relationship clearer.

references.observed: Birds is blue and sing teal; their word identities remain visible as the lesson moves into vectors and attention.
3D cache volume grows with token count while layer and KV-head axes retain meaning and a readable formula remains available.
Four colored invented IDs point directly to matching colored rows, so color encodes an association rather than atmosphere.

principles.why: The viewer can track identity across transformations. Copying the dark palette, serif headings or glow alone does not transfer this benefit.

principles.instruction: Teach operational constraints by running the wrong approach visibly, showing the failure on concrete state, then repairing it. Preserve the consequences and tradeoffs after the repair.

references.observed: Shared reads are safe, competing appends overwrite one branch's key/value, and copy-on-write gives each branch a private partial block; full blocks can remain shared.
A tokenizer ID swap quietly selects the wrong trained row; moving only input rows leaves the separate output table wrong; moving all indexed state together repairs the renumbering.
An allocation fails with the tables unchanged, then alternative recompute and CPU-swap paths recover capacity while showing compute versus link-bandwidth costs.

principles.why: Constraints have causal meaning and lead to a decision a learner can make.

principles.instruction: Author visual changes at measured spoken phrases. Make the relevant object readable when its claim is spoken, clear outgoing content before new content must be read, and leave purposeful time to inspect arithmetic or answer a prediction. Judge holds in context. Preserve teaching completeness before optimizing duration.

references.observed: The new vocabulary item and a held prediction precede the greedy matcher failure.
The viewer receives new block-size and occupancy questions, then the pool and formula resolve their answers in stages.

principles.why: Speech and visuals become one explanation rather than competing reading tracks. Reference films are roughly 21 to 25 minutes, so their quality is not a short runtime rule.

principles.instruction: Distinguish invented examples, exact arithmetic, sourced historical measurements and workload-dependent claims at the moment each matters. Show toy-to-scale reasoning without presenting an illustrative timing or ratio as a benchmark. State the assumptions that change the result.

references.observed: The count-ratio training score is labeled a classroom proxy based on a reconstruction, with BERT's exact training recipe unpublished.
Fixed vocabulary memory arithmetic is separated from language-dependent sequence savings and a historical whole-tokenizer comparison.
Packing, scheduling, KV-head count, precision and dropping positions are compared as different levers; architecture changes and approximation limits remain visible.
Running max, denominator and numerator reproduce the full-row result while the lesson separates temporary attention traffic from persistent KV-cache capacity.

principles.why: Visual confidence does not become scientific overclaiming.

principles.instruction: End the central lesson with a new input or state that requires the learned mechanism. Hold the question, show the computed answer and explain why it follows. Return to the opening problem and use the earned result to connect to the next lesson. A recap or checklist alone is not the payoff.

references.observed: A new state yields q=[2.5,3.5], new scores and shares, and a different output [1.3,1.7] plotted against the prior output.
With block size 32 the learner sizes A/B, releases A, adds C, maps position 40 to physical block 11, then diagnoses a full-pool byte-budget problem.
A snow/snowy/show corpus yields 38 to 29 positions; snowball tests a new greedy dead end; new Unigram probabilities make a two-piece path beat a one-piece path.

principles.why: The viewer demonstrates a capability instead of merely seeing a list of ideas covered.

principles.instruction: Review the exact encoded movie, not just the source or poster. Cover every authored scene and inspect early/middle/late narrative states, transitions, long holds and the ending. Inspect important frames at native resolution and intended playback size. Record exact source/movie hashes and specific scene reasons. Keep sampled frame review, automated decode/layout checks, full-speed listening and publication approval distinct.

references.observed: A native transition frame exposes multiple intermediate digits from motion blur, which a polished held frame does not reveal.
A dark crossfade is a readability candidate; the encoded decoder separately reports no unexplained blank runs, so the still alone does not establish a persistent defect.

principles.why: Technical success and a few strong stills cannot certify pacing, listening quality or every scene's teaching value.

antiPatterns: Applying the reference color palette, serif font, glow or 3D camera to generic boxes and calling the result equivalent.
A single attractive opening followed by static prose cards or an unearned checklist ending.
Numerical labels and geometric quantities authored independently so they can disagree.
Reusing the same board layout for topics with different explanatory structures.
Showing a result before the operation or spoken setup that makes it intelligible.
Deleting hard limits, counterexamples, training/serving distinctions or transfer exercises to make a video shorter.
Calling sampled encoded frames a complete human watch with sound or independent factual certification.
Treating an automated score, decode pass, or source-level assertion as aesthetic approval.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Attention native encoded frame 816.4s, learn scene, frames/sample-0216.png
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: Multiple intermediate percentage and decimal glyphs are visible during a state transition. This may be intentional temporal motion blur; the reviewed still does not establish persistence or audibility mismatch.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Use bounded transition duration, hold a crisp final numerical state, and inspect numerical changes during actual playback before accepting equivalent effects elsewhere.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Attention native encoded frame 847.9s, cost scene, frames/sample-0228.png
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: The previous grid and incoming formula are both dim in the sampled crossfade. Existing encoded decodedFrameAudit.passed is true and unexplainedBlankRuns is empty.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Review the surrounding transition at speed and prefer a retained readable anchor when the narration still relies on a quantity. Do not turn a single dark transition frame into an invented persistent blocker.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Tokenization wordpiece-score, lookup and economics scene sheets; KV Cache size and shrink sheets
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: Some necessary source qualifiers, numeric tables and limitations are smaller than the central diagram. Desktop native frames remain readable for the inspected examples; mobile playback and every qualifier's dwell were not tested here.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: At the intended player size, check that necessary symbols, scope labels and units remain readable for their required duration. Keep a qualifier spoken or visually central when it controls the claim.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Tokenization hook and the three closing scenes
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: Tokenization opens with the rhetorical sentence that the model never reads the user's sentence, and closings include recap labels. Their utility comes from the following transformations and prior computed exercises, not those phrases or summary cards alone.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Prefer a direct mechanism or concrete question in new scripts, and preserve the prior transfer demonstration if using a short recap.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: No continuous full-speed playback with sound, no human listening assessment, no Mac AVFoundation gate, no mobile player inspection, and no independent external fact audit were performed by this reviewer.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Retain those gates explicitly. This analysis provides transferable design evidence and complete sampled scene coverage, not a new publication decision.

bindings.scope: Encoded visual/narration reference analysis; not publication approval or full-speed human sound watch

sceneObservations.limits: These are sampled encoded visual and complete narration observations. They are not continuous playback or independent fact review.

scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: The two-token calculation becomes QK transpose, scaling, row softmax and AV with shape and wrong-axis comparisons.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Single-sequence bidirectional and causal grids contrast with a rectangular two-query/three-source cross-attention grid.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Two different sets of shares and outputs concatenate and mix back into the state; head count and stored score memory retain distinct costs.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states

scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: A 4-by-4 grid becomes 8-by-8 to show quadratic score growth, then real dimensions price memory. Native 847.9s is a dark crossfade candidate, not proven persistent failure.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: One new query row reads persistent keys/values; the cache and temporary scores keep separate cost roles, including head sharing and position masking.

scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Large logits overflow, max subtraction preserves finite-score shares, and a prior matrix-product overflow remains broken until recomputed in a wider type.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Tiles replace the stored full grid while running max, denominator and numerator recover the same result; temporary traffic is separated from cache capacity.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Previously demonstrated shape, normalization, scaling, overflow and cache-position failures return as visible diagnostic examples rather than new unsupported labels.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: A new state changes the query, scores, shares and output, with the new point compared against the earlier output.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: The learned attention path returns inside a transformer block and bridges from word states to image patches after the prior computed transfer test.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: A document and delayed first answer versus later words establish the latency puzzle and one-GPU capacity question.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Repeated triangular computation grows to 21 operations while caching keeps six new computations and visible reused history; the reads remain.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Prompt work runs together, generation feeds its new token back and appends cache state; TTFT and inter-token timing retain different dependencies.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Key/value slabs, layer/head axes and token growth correspond to the cache byte formula; new layer counts pose a prediction before a larger total.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: The same 16-block pool reserves large empty ranges and blocks an arriving request; later waste examples identify the actual trapped space.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Noncontiguous blocks retain logical order through an explicit table lookup; occupied slots drive when the next block is allocated.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: A contiguous read fails on the scattered pool; a table walk restores the same computed attention output, while one invalid sentinel slot corrupts it.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Pending reads, multiple owners and retained prefixes keep blocks alive after an apparent request finish.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: A short request leaves a visible idle slot in static batching; replacement requests and reclaimed pool blocks show continuous batching and its scheduling limits.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Multiple branch tables share prompt blocks; a wrong competing append corrupts data, then a visible copy and coordinated table/refcount changes preserve separate futures.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: The same visible suffix with different pasts hashes differently; full shared blocks, private tails and eviction explain exactly what the illustrative reuse count assumes.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: The full pool rejects a new allocation without changing tables; recompute and CPU-swap alternatives expose compute versus link-bandwidth recovery costs.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: An already packed but oversized pool distinguishes packing from reducing bytes; head count, precision, dropped positions and multiple GPUs carry explicit tradeoffs.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: Per-step new key/value computation stays flat while history reads grow with context and can encounter bandwidth limits.

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states

scenes.inspection: all encoded scene sheet tiles including narrated beat states and sampled transition/end states
scenes.observedTeachingAndVisualMechanism: The opening latency and capacity questions return with cache geometry and the concrete capabilities demonstrated in the transfer exercise.
